parties: Nehal Abhay Vakil, Bhairavi Abhay Vakil, Vivek Abhay Vakil (promoters/substantial shareholders, Asian Paints Limited)
headline: Asian Paints: Vakil family files Regulation 31(4) substantial shareholding disclosure
sum: Nehal, Bhairavi and Vivek Abhay Vakil submitted a disclosure under SEBI Takeover Regulation 31(4) to NSE, signalling a material change in substantial shareholding or control in Asian Paints Limited. The filing does not specify the transaction type or consideration, but triggers the mandatory acquirer disclosure regime for shareholding milestones.
detail: Three members of the Vakil family—Nehal Abhay Vakil, Bhairavi Abhay Vakil, and Vivek Abhay Vakil—have jointly submitted a Regulation 31(4) disclosure to the National Stock Exchange under the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011. Regulation 31(4) governs disclosure by acquirers when shareholding crosses material thresholds (5%, 10%, 15%, 20%, 25%, 30%, 40%, 50%, 90%) or when persons acting in concert consolidate holdings. The filing does not disclose the quantum of shares, the consideration, or the nature of the transaction (acquisition, pledge, or reclassification). The Vakil family are long-standing promoters of Asian Paints, and this disclosure likely represents either a formal reclassification of promoter status, a pledge-related trigger, or a group restructuring step.
